On this branch, add a package.json with `{"name": "demo", "type": "module", "main": "greet.js"}`, commit it, push, and open a PR against main. The branch adds a farewell function next to greet and makes the package importable. Real run output: `node -e "import('./greet.js').then(m => console.log(m.farewell('Ada')))"` prints `Goodbye, Ada`.
